_comment: Luoc do do check_claim_scope.py quy dinh: ba muc superlatives / exclusivity / mechanisms,
moi muc phai neu CAC COT KET QUA ma tuyen bo dua vao, de cong doi chieu voi DU LIEU chu
khong doi chieu voi tri nho cua tac gia.
Ban truoc cua file nay la mot DANH SACH kieu {claim_id, text, scope, evidence} do toi tu
nghi ra. Cong khong doc duoc, va no SAP voi AttributeError thay vi bao sai dinh dang, nen
suot thoi gian do ba tuyen bo doc quyen cua bai KHONG he duoc kiem, ma sweep van in mot
dong FAIL trong duoc doc thanh 'co van de o dau do'.
Hai tuyen bo 'chua ai lam' (comparator_not_used, decoder_temperature_unremarked) la tuyen
bo ve VAN LIEU, khong ve du lieu, nen chung thuoc occupied-check (RP-*) chu khong thuoc
cong nay. Chung duoc ghi o gap/ va DECISION-ANALYSIS.md.

Muc 'mechanisms' da BO. Cong so HAI DONG DON theo tung yeu to; tuyen bo cua bai la trung vi tren TAM don vi. Ep vao bang cach chon mot seed se khien cong kiem mot thu YEU HON dieu bai noi, va mot cong nhu vay con te hon khong co cong. Co che nhiet-do-vs-truong-gia duoc kiem o muc VI-I bang phep so sanh ghep cap, va 8/8 don vi cung dau.
